findings.title: Same-product lock queues complete workflows; increment scopes prohibited
findings.evidence: Two different members submitted before either completed. Both delivered, but producer intervals 1794974550.8831778–1794974552.89037 and 1794974568.987239–1794974570.993733 never overlap. Extra installed scope rejected: Shared product scope revision requires separate requirement.
findings.impact: Main multi-user same-product parallel objective unmet; disjoint modules cannot be added to existing product. Identical-write example alone cannot prove disjoint conflict behavior; lock code plus explicit disjoint-scope refusal establish the broader blocker.
findings.repair: Plan outside product critical section. Hold short product/DB lock only while atomically reserving seed revisions and persisting exact entry/task mapping. Merge additive scope namespace with deterministic provenance. Launch independent workers after releasing lock; serialize only actual overlapping write contracts and channel publication CAS/integration conflicts. Do not merely delete lock.

findings.title: First historical authority match blocks valid new credentials
findings.evidence: After owner logout and fresh login, renewed entry authorize(key)=true but planning held with Entry credential withdrawn. Still-valid colleague new entry authorize(key)=true reaches planned then fails same error. Original owner entry authorize=false. Requirement callback matches old same-actor row; release configuration selects first product row. module_authority and continuous_policies have analogous first-row coupling.
findings.impact: Ordinary session logout/expiry can strand product for valid collaborators; new independent tasks and historical read rights are conflated with revoked old entry capabilities.
findings.repair: Pass exact entry mandate through planner/current and exact task/contribution provenance through mutable operations. Separate immutable accepted-publication/provenance facts and current same-tenant authorized read from current authorization for fresh effects. Fresh task may use its own valid entry and accepted immutable baseline; never replace revoked unfinished original contribution credentials with another entry grant. Review/publication of unfinished originals must recheck every original. Release configure/read authorization must bind intended current operation and product policy, not historical first entry.

findings.title: Continuous coordinator and dependency resolver remain historical and actor-local
findings.evidence: continuous_policies chooses first receipt coordinator/base for product. native_continuous.enqueue rejects changed lane actor/policy (lines 276–277), and _drive switches to fixed coordinator. plan resolves dependencies only inside receipt mapping; next_issues enumerates only actor entries. Existing event machinery is real, but factory does not supply product-wide cross-member dependency semantics.
findings.impact: Lock shortening alone does not produce shared global work graph or safe recovery when original coordinator loses access.
findings.repair: Store tenant/product task identities with exact accepted upstream contract/source revisions and original mandates; wake newly ready dependents on durable acceptance/source/credential/handoff events, including other members. Add explicit authorized coordinator transfer with old/new policy revisions and CAS, tenant/current write checks, reconciliation of in-flight physical publication before transfer, durable audit and wakeup. Unknown publishing ownership stays held; coordinator transfer cannot reauthorize revoked original contributions.

findings.title: Entry completion uses entire requirement progress
findings.evidence: consume_product enumerates all issues of requirement, including other entries, before completing current entry parent; then requires whole-requirement percent==100. Static finding also supplied by root; no redundant execution.
findings.impact: With real overlapping execution, a correctly completed entry can fail while another is still running; global requirement completion and entry delivery must be distinct.
findings.repair: Settle each entry only from its exact mapping and accepted/publication receipts. Keep requirement aggregate/overall parent incomplete until all required associated entries and original acceptance are met; do not report 100% just because one entry delivered.
